functions.name: c00_simple_if
functions.source: static bool c00_simple_if(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: One top-level if adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c01_nested_if
functions.source: static bool c01_nested_if(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a) { if (b) return true; } return false; }
functions.derivation: The outer if adds 1; the nested if adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c02_triple_nested_if
functions.source: static bool c02_triple_nested_if(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a) { if (b) { if (c) return true; } } return false; }
functions.derivation: Three nested ifs add 1, 2, and 3 respectively.

functions.name: c03_if_else
functions.source: static bool c03_if_else(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a) return true; else return false; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if and its else each add one; else is hybrid.

functions.name: c04_if_elif_else
functions.source: static bool c04_if_elif_else(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a) return true; else if (b) return false; else return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if, else-if, and else each add one; else-if is hybrid.

functions.name: c05_three_way_chain
functions.source: static bool c05_three_way_chain(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a) return true; else if (b) return false; else if (c) return true; else return false; return false; }
functions.derivation: One if, two else-if branches, and one else add four total.

functions.name: c06_and_sequence
functions.source: static bool c06_and_sequence(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a && b) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1 and the same-operator && sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c07_or_sequence
functions.source: static bool c07_or_sequence(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a || b) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1 and the same-operator || sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c08_mixed_boolean
functions.source: static bool c08_mixed_boolean(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a && b || c && d) return true; return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; &&, ||, && form three logical sequences, adding 3.

functions.name: c09_assigned_boolean
functions.source: static bool c09_assigned_boolean(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { bool value = a && b; return value; return false; }
functions.derivation: A binary logical sequence in an assignment adds one fundamental increment.

functions.name: c10_while_loop
functions.source: static bool c10_while_loop(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { while (a) { a = false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: One top-level while adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c11_for_loop
functions.source: static bool c11_for_loop(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { } return false; }
functions.derivation: One top-level loop adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c12_if_with_loop
functions.source: static bool c12_if_with_loop(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { } } return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; the loop nested inside it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c13_nested_loops
functions.source: static bool c13_nested_loops(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { while (a) { break; } } return false; }
functions.derivation: The outer loop adds 1; the inner loop adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c14_switch_or_match
functions.source: static bool c14_switch_or_match(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { switch (a) { case true: return true; default: return false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: The switch/match/select construct adds one; its alternatives add no further points.

functions.name: c15_switch_nested_if
functions.source: static bool c15_switch_nested_if(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { switch (a) { case true: if (b) return true; break; default: return false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: The switch adds 1; the if nested in it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c16_try_one_catch
functions.source: static bool c16_try_one_catch(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { try { if (a) return true; } catch (const std::exception& error) { return false; } return false; }
functions.derivation: Try is ignored; the if adds 1 and each catch adds 1.

functions.name: c17_try_two_catches
functions.source: static bool c17_try_two_catches(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { try { if (a) return true; } catch (int error) { return false; } catch (...) { return true; } return false; }
functions.derivation: Try is ignored; the if adds 1 and each of two catch clauses adds 1.

functions.name: c18_recursive_call
functions.source: static bool c18_recursive_call(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a) return true; return c18_recursive_call(b, a, c, d); return false; }
functions.derivation: The base-case if adds 1; one direct recursive call adds 1 fundamental recursion increment.

functions.name: c19_conditional_expression
functions.source: static bool c19_conditional_expression(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { return a ? true : false; return false; }
functions.derivation: One ternary/conditional expression adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c20_nested_conditionals
functions.source: static bool c20_nested_conditionals(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { return a ? true : (b ? false : true); return false; }
functions.derivation: The outer conditional adds 1; its nested conditional adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c21_lambda_decision
functions.source: static bool c21_lambda_decision(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { auto predicate = [a](bool value) { if (value) return true; return false; }; return predicate(a); return false; }
functions.derivation: The lambda adds no structural point but raises nesting; its if adds 1 + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c22_if_lambda_decision
functions.source: static bool c22_if_lambda_decision(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a) { auto predicate = [b](bool value) { if (value) return true; return false; }; return predicate(b); } return false; }
functions.derivation: Outer if adds 1; lambda if adds 1 + 2 nesting levels (outer if and lambda).

functions.name: c23_nested_callable
functions.source: static bool c23_nested_callable(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { auto inner = [a]() { if (a) return true; return false; }; return inner(); return false; }
functions.derivation: Nested callable adds no structural point but one nesting level to its if (1 + 1).

functions.name: c24_comprehension
functions.source: static bool c24_comprehension(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { return std::ranges::any_of(std::array{a,b}, [](bool value) { return value; }); }
functions.derivation: The filter lambda contains no control-flow break; the collection pipeline is a sequence of calls.

functions.name: c25_labeled_jump
functions.source: static bool c25_labeled_jump(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { goto done; done: return false; return false; }
functions.derivation: The goto adds one fundamental increment.

functions.name: c26_boolean_sequence
functions.source: static bool c26_boolean_sequence(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { return a && b; }
functions.derivation: The return expression has one contiguous && operator sequence, which adds one fundamental increment; it contains no structural break.

functions.name: c27_language_idiom
functions.source: template <typename T> static bool c27_language_idiom(T a, T b, bool c, bool d) { return a == b; }
functions.derivation: The template declaration and equality comparison contain no structural break or logical-operator sequence.

functions.name: c28_loop_if_boolean
functions.source: static bool c28_loop_if_boolean(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { if (a && b) return true; } return false; }
functions.derivation: Loop adds 1; nested if adds 1 + 1 nesting; its && sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c29_else_loop
functions.source: static bool c29_else_loop(bool a, bool b, bool c, bool d) { if (a) return true; else { while (b) { break; } } return false; }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; its else adds 1. The loop in the else body is at nesting level 1, so it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting, totaling 4.
